clips.title: The story
paras: Glutton Shackles are enchanted restraints worn by Moonrage Glutton worgen in Silverpine Forest. Crafted by the mad archmage Arugal, these bands channel magic to bolster his otherwise flawed sorcery and sustain his cursed lupine creations.

To the trained mages of the Forsaken, the feral worgen infesting Silverpine are not merely savage monstrosities—they are evidence of gross arcane ineptitude. Dalar Dawnweaver, an accomplished arcanist stationed at the Sepulcher, holds nothing but contempt for Archmage Arugal, deeming him an incompetent hack unworthy of the Kirin Tor. Dawnweaver discovered that Arugal relied on enchanted relics to compensate for his fragile spells. The Glutton Shackles, worn by the heavy Moonrage Gluttons wandering northern Silverpine, act as magical anchors that reinforce the curse binding the beasts.
